tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rnam thar mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon/

khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po gtsang stag tshang gi lo tsā ba sgra pa shes rab rin chen nam stag lo smra ba'i nyi ma zhes bya ba mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi cha la gangs can gyi mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par mtho zhing snyan pa'i grags dkar srid rtse'i gong ba las kyang ches cher brgal ba/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa/ bdud dang phyir rgol ba gang gis kyang 'gran pa'i rngo mi thogs pa lhag bcas 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur pa de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa mdo tsam zhig brjod pa la/ de yang sku bltams pa'i yul ni 'dzam gling sa yi thig le gangs can bod chen po'i ljongs 'dir/ chos dang rig pa'i 'byung gnas dbus gtsang sa yi cha la stod smad gnyis su phye ba'i stod gtsang gi phyogs*/ de la yang g.yas ru dang g.yon ru gnyis su phye ba'i gtsang g.yas ru lang 'gro khang dmar zhes par/ yul gyi dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas su/ yab don grub rgyal po dang yum lha mo rgyal gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bdun pa'i shing bya lor dge legs kyi mtshan ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum nas lo chen chos kyi rgyal po skyabs mchog dpal bzang po'i drung du/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa yang dag pa mnos| mtshan dkon mchog skyabs zhes gsol/ dgung grangs bdun la phebs skabs rig gnas kun gyi phyi mo yi ge 'bri klog bslabs pas zla ba gcig gi ring legs par mkhyen/ de mtshams slob dpon thag ring du 'byon dgos pa'i rkyen byung nas/ yig phrug bco lnga'i skor yod pa gyes par chas pa na/ slob dpon gyis khong la yig phrug rgan po rnams kyis 'khrid grogs gyis gsungs nas ma gyes par so nams ran ran du bskyangs pas kun gyis ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa la sogs sku na gzhon nu nyid nas mkhyen rab kyi grags dkar phyogs kun tu 'bar/

gzhan yang sku gzhon nu nyid nas tshe sngon gi bag chags bzang po'i mkhyen brtse'i klong rdol ba'i chos rgyal ma lta bu'i bstod pa dang smon lam tsam ni lan re bris pas blo la zin zhing*/ lo rgyus 'bring po tsam ni gdangs ma 'don pa thos pa tsam gyi blor zin pa sogs mkhyen pa dang*/ rgyal sras thogs med kyi rnam thar bklogs pas dad gus kyi mchi ma 'khrigs nas klog mtshams 'jogs dgos pa sogs dam pa'i rigs kyi mos gus gting tshugs pa dang*/ bzod dka'i sdug bsngal gyi mnar ba'i mtha' med 'gro ba rnams la snying rje dang*/ nges 'byung gi kun bslangs drag pos khyim nas khyim med par rab du byung ba'i thugs 'dun zab mo yod par gnas skabs mngon 'gyur ma byung yang*/gzhon nu'i dus nas kyang bcom ldan grags pa 'phel dang*/ rgyal ston rin po che sogs yongs 'dzin bcu phrag lhag las dbang lung dang skyabs khrid mang du zhus/ dgung lo brgyad tsam la thob rgyal du yig mkhan la 'bod mi bstud mar byung bar lo brgyad kyi ring bzhugs/ de'i ring la yang 'jam dbyangs kyis rang gis dam bcas pa'i gzungs ring stong phrag re dang*/ mtshan brjod gang 'grub/ sgrol ma dang rnam rgyal nyi shu rtsa re chags med byas/ rtsis dang yi ge rdo dang mchongs la sogs pa pho rtsal sna dguu sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i mthong thos kun gyis snyan pa sgrog pa byung*/ de dus tsam na rin spungs nang so nor bzang sku mched kyis phyag phyir sdod dgos zhes nan gyis gsungs shing*| khyad par rin spungs nang so dpon gyis gzhis dang gzhi ba sbrags nas ster ba sogs gnas skabs kyi phun tshogs du ma mngon du gyur yang*/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni srid rtse nas mnar med bar gyi 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtha' dag me mur 'ob dang*/ dug sbrul gyi tshang ltar mthong ba'i nges 'byung rnam par dag pas rgyud bskul nas dgung lo nyi shu par chos 'khor du rab byung sgrub par gsang thabs kyi phebs/

de yi nyin mo nas 'brom ston rin po che'i rnam 'phrul mkhan rin po che seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mkhan po mdzad/ 'ug tshang rin po che tshul khrims dpal bzang pos slob dpon mdzad/ slob dpon rin po che grags bzang pas dus go ba mdzad nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan la shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ de nas zhag shas mtshams gsung rab kun gyi mig gcig pur gyur pa'i phar phyin gyi gzhung la gsan zhing bu ṭika blor bzung lo chen gyi dus chen nyin tshig don gyi cha la lhag chad dang nor 'khrul bral ba'i sgo nas legs par bshad pas gzur gnas blo ldan kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog pas de dag gi bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor/ de'i phyi lo ston kar lo chen gyi dus mchod nyin mkhas mang kyi dbus su mdo rtsa'i grwa skor byas pas mkhan rin po che legs par dgyes te bsngags brjod dang bcas/ khyod kyi grwa skor po ti re re la/ nged kyis gos sna re re ster gsung zhing dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ de nas chos rje byang sems chen po'i drung mngon pa kun btus dang*/ de rjes mdzod kyi bshad khrid gsan/ chos rje mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags pa bzang po las/ phar tshad/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa gong 'og rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/ byams chos phyi ma bzhi rnams kyi 'grel ba dang bcas pa'i bshad pa gsan zhing*/ slob gnyer de dag gi ring la yang*/ rgya ston rin po che'i drung du/ kyai rdor/ gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed sogs kyi dbang bskur dang*/ slob dpon rin po che'i drung du/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs zhus shing*/ grangs bsnyen rdzogs par bskyal/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa'i drung du/ gzhung khrid dang rjes gnang 'ga' zhig gsan/ gzhan yang slob dpon rin po che'i drung du gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs/

rims lnga gsal sgron/ spyod bsdus/ sngags rim sogs dge ldan pa'i gsang 'dus kyi yig cha mtha' dag gi bshad pa thob pas mtshon kha 'bab kyi klung rnams rgya mtsho bzhin du rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' mtha' dag zab yangs kyi thugs mtshor yongs su gtams/ de rjes dbus su phebs lo gnyis lhag bzhugs ring bstan 'dzin 'gran zla dang bral ba gsum gtsug tu bsten zhing dbu phar sogs kyi gzhung la gsan bsam mdzad pa las/ thog ma 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan gyi drung nas/ rtsa 'jug sogs gzhung lugs bcu bzhi tsam gyi bshad khrid gsan zhing*/ chos rje yon rgyam pa las kyang*/ phar tshad/ rtsa 'jugarnam nges/ rigs thigs/ mngon pa mdzod rnams la legs par sbyang*/ de rjes rong ston chen po shākya rgyal mtshan gyi drung 'bum ṭīka dang*/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi ṭīkka'i stod dang*/ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang sogs gsan zhing*/ gsang phur dka' chen bzhi sogs gzhung nyer gnyis tsam gyi mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i dbus su grwa skor byas pas/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i chen po kun gyi spobs pa bsnyil shing dbus gtsang gi ston grags yongs kyis ngo mtshar ba'i bsngags brjod kyi me tog lan brgya gtor/ de dag gi ring rong ston chen pos grwa skor gyi ston mthong dgyes bzhin du gnang ba dang/ bstan pa'i khur bskur/ shin tu dgyes par mdzad do/ /de rjes gtsang du phebs byang gling gi 'chad nyan byas/ de'i ring la'ang chos rje byang sems chen po'i drung du/ sa sde lnga'i lung*/ bslab btus sgron gsal/ nyer mkho'i rgyud mang po'i lung*/ dus 'khor rtsa 'grel/ sbyor drug lam 'bras/ bde mchog gi khrid/ nyams len gyi gnad dang*/ zhal shes khyad par rnams kyang mtshan mo'i cha la'ang gnyid bcag nas zhus/ zha lur grub pa'i dbang phyug rin chen bsod nams 'phel las/ dus 'khor gyi bshad pa sogs chos skor mang du gsan/

shab dpal sdings su/ sems dpa' chen po skad gnyis pa thugs rje dpal bzang po'i drung nas ka lā pa sogs sgra yi bshad pa gsan/ de yi phyi lo chos 'khor du chos rje lo tsā ba'i mdun/ snyan ngag dang sdeb sbyor mngon brjod sogs thun mong gi rig gnas kun la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad*/ shab smad bkra shis gling du/ 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rin po che/ bdag po grags pa blo gros pa'i drung du chos skyong che chung gi rjes gnang dang*/ las tshogs kyi lung dang bcas pa/ shin tu rgyas pa tshang la rdzogs pa thob/ rgyal rtser bo dong chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal bar mjal/ gzim khang du de nyid 'dus pa'i don bsdus nas thugs las dang*/ khroms chos su spyod 'jug gsungs/ gzhan yang dam pa de'i mdun/ dus 'khor dang kyai rdor sogs dkyil 'khor dgu bcu lhag tsam gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rgyud rang rang gi thob thang gang yin chad lhag nor gsum dang bral bar legs par thob/ rje byang sems pa'i drung nas dpal ldan sa skya'i pha chos gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i chos mang po gsan/ gzhan yang byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i zhal slob/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang dang*/ zhwa lu ba rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ lo chen thugs rje dpal bzang sogs tshe 'dir mkhas grub kyi yongs 'dzin nyer bdun tsam legs par bsten nas thun mong gi rig gnas bzo dang gso ba rig pa nas gsang sngags bla med kyi bar gyi mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag gcig pu ru gyur zhing*/ nang du thos don nyams su bzhes pa'i ting nge 'dzin la nyams len gtso bo mdzad pa'i nyams rtogs grub pa'i yon tan kyang phul du byung bar brnyes/ gzhan la 'chad pa yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che tshar gcig dang*| bstan bcos ni rang gi rnam bshad byas pa rnams tshar re ma bshad pa med cing*/

khyed par dka' chen bzhi dang mdzod rtsa 'jug byams chos sogs tshar 'ga' re dang*/ yang dgos 'dul ba dang*/ sgra dang dus 'khor ni shin tu mang po dang*/ gzhan yang 'od ldan rtsa 'grel/ mngon pa phran mang po tshad ma sde bdun| jo bo chen po'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa gzhan la 'doms par mdzad cing*/ spyi sgos kyi bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mdzad pa'ang kun shes bzhi sogs rang dbang du brtsams pa dang*/ gsol 'debs dang*/ rnam thar/ bstod tshogs dang rtogs brjod/ sdeb sbyor gyi skor chos tshan brgya rtsa tsam dang*/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba legs gsung 'dul ba'i skor la/ mdo rtsa'i ṭīka chen dang*/ rtsis tshigs bcad ma sogs/ bstan pa'i gzhung shing sgra dang tshad ma la/ ka lā pa'i ṭīka chen/ tsanṭa pa'i ṭīka chung sogs sgra dang*/ rnam 'grel ṭīka chen dang*/ rig gter ṭīkka sogs tshad ma'i skor dang*/ bstan pa'i snying po mdo sde dang mngon pa las/ mdo sde'i phar phyin ṭīkka saugs dang*/ mngon pa la tha snyad pa'i mngon pa la/ mdzod kyi ṭīka chen/ kun btus ṭīkka sogs/ don dam pa'i mngon pa la/ rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/ mdo kun las btus pa/ rtog ge 'bar ba sogs kyi rnam bshad dang*/ mdo sngags spyi'i nyams len sdom pa gsum po'i rnam gzhag sogs dang*/ bstan pa'i gtso bo rdo rje theg pa la/ bya rgyud| spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang*/ bstan pa'i yang rtse rnal 'byor bla med la pha rgyud ma rgyud/ gnyis med sogs kyi skor la ṭīkka dang mngon dkyil mang po zhig dang*/ bstan pa'i mthar thug dus kyi 'khor lo'i skor la spyi don chen mo bstan pa'i rgya mtsho dang rol mtsho bdun sogs rje rang gi dngos slob 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dpal 'byor gyis phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa pod chen bcu gsum tsam yod par gsungs/

khyad par skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba chen por gyur pas/ sdeb sbyor rin 'byung sogs gsar du sgyur ba dang*/ zhal lung grol thig sgrub thabs kun bzang gi rnam bshad sogs dang*/ gsang 'dus dkyil chog lo chen dang smri ti'i 'gyur la 'gyur bcos dang*/ brgyad stong pa landza'i gser bris rje rang gis mdzad pa la/ bod skad dngul gyi bris pa'i brda khyad 'phags can sogs skad gnyis kyi bya ba yang mang po mdzad/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa yang 'khon gyi gdung brgyud bdag po nam mkha' legs kyis bskul ba ltar rtse gdong rin chen sgang gi dgon pa phyag btab shing gur brtag saṃ bhu ṭi sogs kyi 'chad nyan legs par tshugs/ gser gling gi dgon pa btab lo der dge 'dun brgyad cu skor gyi 'du tshogs dang bslab khrims dge 'dun gyi bca' sgrig sogs legs par tshugs| yar 'brog khri dpon rgyal bu lhun grub kyis gsol ba btab par brte/ shing lug lor thar gling chos sde chen po'i 'gram bting lo gnyis tsam gyi grub dge 'dun nyis brgya skor gyi 'du tshogs tshugs 'chad nyan gyi rgyun btsugs/ chos 'khor gyi gdan sa yun ring mdzad pas chos 'khor pa zhes grags pa byung*/ gzhan yang sa skya pa chen po nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis bla mar bsten nas| chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya sogs la'ang chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab par bskor/ gzhan yang thugs sras rnams kyi thu bo brag nag mkhas grub nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la bka' bsgos nas brag nag tu dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus sogs rgyud 'brel gyi bshad thabs gting tshugs par mdzad| mdor na sku tshe hril por 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi phrin las rgya cher spel nas/ phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pur gyur pa rgyal bstan rin po che la thugs gzu bor gnas nas byi dor rnam dag mdzad cing*/

thugs sras zhal slob kyi tshogs dpag med cig bzhugs pa las/ dpal sa skya'i bdag chen nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang*/ zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ brag nag mkhas grub nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ se ra ba blo gros seng ge rta nag pa nor bzang rgya mtsho/ rje rang gi gdan sa pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dpal 'byor/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal sogs gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod cing*/ mthar dgung grangs don gsum pa ste me bya phyi lo 1477lo'i zla bcu ba'i tshes nyi shu'i snga dror zhi bar gshegs so// //zhes dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas thub bstan nyi mas/ PAGE stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rnam thar mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon/ PAGE -PAGE 22--PAGE 13-
